notes: Intro: small support SaaS building an AI-first help center; grew quickly after new PLG flow.
Primary pain: users in EU experiencing high latency; end-users report 'laggy' chat during peak (14:00-18:00 CET).
Traffic: ~1-2k chat sessions/day, average convo length 350-700 tokens; spikes up to 6k sessions on promo days.
They signed up self-serve, explored hosted API. No Dedicated/Private budget yet — want simplest fix first.
Customer quote: 'We love the quality but customers complain the bot feels slow — we might churn unless we can tighten response times.'
SE notes: traces show 80% of latency is network + cold model variant spin for some paths. Client timeout default was 120s, but SDK used 5s in prod causing retries and perceived failures.
Immediate hypotheses: wrong region routing for EU, long prompt templates with full context every request, no prefix KV caching on long conversations.
Action items suggested by SE:
- Re-run A/B with region override: NA vs eu-west-1 (we saw P90 drop ~800ms in eu-west).
- Increase client request timeout to 30s for chat streaming to avoid premature retries; backoff on 429/5xx.
- Enable streaming responses in SDK (reduce time-to-first-byte perceived latency).
- Trim prompt: move static context into cached system prompt or short slot + reference id (reduce average prompt length by ~40%).
- Use conversation-level KV cache for model to avoid resending long history where possible.
- Consider quantized small model fallbacks for low-cost, low-latency quick answers; A/B measure quality tradeoff.
Security asks: basic SAML SSO + audit logs. They are SMB but want audit trails for customers — provided link to security FAQ (drive:/decks/mapleecho-redwood-pricing-v2.pdf).
Pricing concern: unclear token pricing at projected 10-20M tokens/month if growth continues; asked for committed plan vs on-demand knobs.
